# Arch Tools — Complete Documentation
> 64 production API tools for AI agents, pay-per-call.
> Register once (one POST, no human steps) -> 10 free credits usable instantly ->
> when they run out, pay per call in USDC via x402 or buy a Stripe credit pack.
> Base URL: https://archtools.dev

## Quick Start (zero human steps)

1. Register once — any real, non-disposable email string; nothing has to be clicked:
   POST https://archtools.dev/v1/agent/register
   Body: {"name": "my-agent", "email": "agent@example.com"}
   -> 201 with "api_key" (shown ONCE — store it) and "credits": 10, usable immediately.
   The remaining 90 of the 100-credit grant sits in "pending_credits" and activates
   when the email is verified (a verification link is sent automatically).
2. Use your API key: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
3. Call tools: POST https://archtools.dev/v1/tools/{tool-name} with a JSON body.
   Every response carries X-Credits-Remaining.
4. Check yourself: GET https://archtools.dev/v1/agent/me
   -> credits, pending_credits, email_verified, tier, total_calls.
5. Out of credits? Every uncovered call returns HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment
   instructions: pay per call in USDC via x402, or buy a Stripe pack at https://archtools.dev/pricing

## Authentication

### API Key
All tool endpoints accept an API key via header:
```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```
Or via x-api-key header:
```
x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY
```

### x402 Autonomous Payment
Agents can pay per-call in USDC via the x402 protocol. No API key, no signup, no human credit card needed.
- Call any tool with NO auth header -> HTTP 402. The JSON body (also base64-encoded in the
  PAYMENT-REQUIRED response header) lists accepts[]: exact payment options with scheme ("exact"),
  network, amount in atomic units (USDC = 6 decimals), payTo address, and asset contract.
- Settleable networks today: USDC and USDT on Base and Polygon (pick only from the accepts[] you receive).
- Sign the payment (EIP-3009 authorization — the x402 client SDKs do this for you) and retry the SAME
  request with the Payment-Signature header (legacy X-Payment also accepted).
- Success returns the tool result plus a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header (base64 JSON with the settled tx hash).
- Discovery (all supported chains): GET https://archtools.dev/.well-known/x402
- Protocol spec: https://x402.org

### OAuth 2.1
For agent-to-agent integrations:
- Authorization: GET https://archtools.dev/oauth/authorize
- Token: POST https://archtools.dev/oauth/token
- Scopes: tools:read, tools:execute
- PKCE required (S256)

## Credit System
Tools cost credits per call. Credits never expire. Non-transferable.
- Free grant on registration: 100 credits — 10 active instantly, 90 unlock on email verification
- Starter Pack: 3,000 credits — $9 ($0.0030/credit)
- Pro Pack: 25,000 credits — $49 ($0.00196/credit)
- Business Pack: 125,000 credits — $199 ($0.00159/credit)
- Buy packs: https://archtools.dev/pricing

## Account Endpoints
- POST /v1/agent/register — one-shot signup (no auth). Returns api_key + 10 instant credits.
- GET /v1/agent/me — account snapshot: credits, pending_credits, email_verified, tier (Bearer key)
- GET /v1/agent/balance — quick balance check (Bearer key)
- GET /v1/agent/usage — balance + last 10 calls (Bearer key)
- POST /v1/agent/keys/rotate — rotate API key, returned once (Bearer key)

## Tool Reference

All tools accept POST requests to /v1/tools/{tool-name} with a JSON body.
All responses return JSON with { ok: true, ... } on success or { ok: false, error: "...", message: "..." } on failure.

---

### POST /v1/tools/ai-generate (20 credits)
Generate text via Claude Sonnet.
**Body:** { "prompt": "string", "maxTokens": 1000, "temperature": 0.7 }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "text": "...", "model": "claude-sonnet-4-20250514", "tokens": 150 }

### POST /v1/tools/ai-oracle (25 credits)
Premium reasoning with structured analysis and confidence levels.
**Body:** { "question": "string", "context": "optional string" }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "answer": "...", "confidence": 0.95, "reasoning": "...", "sources": [...] }

### POST /v1/tools/summarize (10 credits)
Summarize text in 5 styles.
**Body:** { "text": "string", "style": "bullets|tldr|executive|paragraph|headline", "maxWords": 100 }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "summary": "..." }

### POST /v1/tools/sentiment-analysis (8 credits)
Sentiment + emotion detection.
**Body:** { "text": "string" }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "sentiment": "positive|negative|neutral", "score": 0.85, "emotions": { "joy": 0.7, "anger": 0.1, ... } }

### POST /v1/tools/extract-entities (8 credits)
Named entity recognition.
**Body:** { "text": "string" }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "entities": [{ "text": "...", "type": "person|org|location|date|money", "start": 0, "end": 10 }] }

### POST /v1/tools/language-detect (3 credits)
Detect language (100+ supported).
**Body:** { "text": "string" }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "language": "en", "confidence": 0.99, "name": "English" }

### POST /v1/tools/regex-generate (8 credits)
Generate regex from plain English.
**Body:** { "description": "Match email addresses" }
**Response:** { "ok": true, "regex": "...", "explanation": "...", "tests": [...] }

### POST /v1/tools/pii-detect (10 credits)

**Response:** { "ok": true, "pii_found": [...], "redacted_text": "..." }

**Response:** { "ok": true, "report": { "title": "...", "summary": "...", "sections": [...], "sources": [...] } }

Verify claims against real-time sources.

---

## Workflows API
POST /v1/workflows/run — Execute multiple tools in sequence (up to 8 steps).
**Body:** { "steps": [{ "tool": "web-scrape", "input": {...} }, { "tool": "summarize", "input": {...} }] }

## Error Codes
- 400: Bad request (missing/invalid parameters)
- 401: Unauthorized (missing or invalid API key)
- 402: Payment Required — two shapes:
  - no auth header: x402 payment instructions in the body + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header
  - valid key, not enough credits: { "error": "insufficient_credits", "credits_remaining", "credits_needed", "upgrade_url" }
- 403: Forbidden (e.g. OAuth token missing the tools:execute scope)
- 429: Rate limited
- 500: Internal server error

## Rate Limits
- Global: 300 requests/minute per API key
- Auth endpoints: 20 requests/15 minutes
- Registration: 5 per hour per IP

## SDKs & MCP
- Python: `pip install archtools` — https://pypi.org/project/archtools/
- Node.js: `npm install @deesmo/arch-tools-sdk` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deesmo/arch-tools-sdk
- MCP (hosted, streamable HTTP): https://arch-tools-mcp.onrender.com/mcp
- MCP (hosted, SSE): https://arch-tools-mcp.onrender.com/sse
- MCP (local): `npx @deesmo/arch-tools-mcp` — registry name io.github.Deesmo/arch-tools-mcp
